A_product_outcome.reason: This peer review performed source tracing only. No native UI/browser run or heavy verification was authorized, so picker behavior and real request resumption are not claimed as observed.

findings: Membership enumeration now filters iam.organizations by archived_at IS NULL; stale stored archived choices consequently fail membership matching and are cleared before request resolution.
Removing the singleton-membership auto-selection enforces an explicit device choice even when one open organization exists.

Concurrent initial validations for the same user share one promise. Storage change generation checks prevent a validation already in flight from certifying or clearing a newer local selection; a final identity check prevents a prior user's read from being applied after identity changes.

Warm requests still read device storage and current identity, while avoiding repeated membership/database reads after successful validation. Remote archive or membership changes are not detected instantly within that execution context; the server remains authoritative and rejects requests that are no longer valid, with revalidation on a later context or explicit local selection change.
Known P2 efficiency limitation remains: the first no-selection hold performs membership enumeration in resolution and again to distinguish zero memberships from a pending choice.
B_source_correctness.verification: Reviewed changed resolver, storage change wrapper, and organization hook call paths, plus added unit cases. Tests were not executed under this lane.
